lines.text: Shields up. Corridors first, rooms second. I've buried people who did it the other way round.
Third depth is where the village is. Deeper Beacon, deeper hole.
Whisper. Front or back, pick one. Rafters are not a formation.
That one nearly had me. Good line-holding.
Dax. You fight like you are late for something.
Priest. You stood in the fire and did not flinch. I have known men who did that. None of them were dead.
Yev. Your people took a village from me. I know it was not you. I am telling you so you know I know.
Home. Never thought I'd say it about a scrap yard.
Watch the grates. Drones nest under them.
